visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair wearing a blue t-shirt with an eagle logo lies on a bed with yellow-patterned sheets. A large brown and black tabby cat with a white chest and paws is sitting directly on his stomach. The man holds a smartphone in his left hand, aiming it towards the cat's rear. The bedroom background features a light-colored wooden wardrobe and a grey pet stroller. (2) The man lowers the phone and begins petting the cat's back with his right hand. The cat remains seated, looking slightly disgruntled or calm. Text overlays in Chinese appear periodically at the center of the frame. (3) The man shifts his body, attempting to sit up, but the cat does not budge, maintaining its weight on his torso. The camera zooms in on the cat's face, showing its green eyes and twitching ears. (4) The cat begins to knead and scratch the man's denim jeans near his thigh. The man reacts by talking and gesturing with his hands. (5) The cat eventually settles down further, lying horizontally across the man's lap and chest. The man continues to pet the cat as it closes its eyes, appearing to fall asleep.
